entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data independently corroborate the component's substantive Latin and expose accidental editorial variants for collation.

locator.section: RG 115 a; conclusion and textual Amen w015–w036

entries.claim: RG 115 a in the Benziger printing supplies the full Father-directed conclusion and textual Amen for w015–w036. The printed proper abbreviation is Per Dominum; no eundem is added. The witness declares house accents, ligatures, tuum: Qui and final Amen. in place of the rubric typography; this is an expansion, not complete diplomatic wording on the proper page.

The Benziger printing on p. 336 directly prints the 14-word proper body w001–w014 and its abbreviated Per Dominum cue. The full conclusion and textual Amen w015–w036 are expanded through separately cited general rubrics, not fully printed on this proper page.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.
